definitions.explanation: Products that have been brought in from another country for sale or use.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: This store deals in imported goods.

examples.japanese: {輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国産品|こくさんひん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Imported goods are often more expensive than domestic products.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Tariffs may apply to imported goods from Europe.

notes:
{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん} is a compound of ⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧ (import) and ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods). It refers to any product brought in from abroad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧: to handle imported goods
- {輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: tariffs are imposed on imports
- {輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧: to rely on imports
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}: high-end imported goods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {輸出品|ゆしゅつひん}: exported goods
- {国産品|こくさんひん}: domestically produced goods

USAGE:
Often appears in discussions about trade, pricing, and consumer choices. In Japan, {輸入品|ゆにゅうひん} can carry connotations of being either luxury items (European brands) or affordable alternatives (imported food).
